verdict.rationale: Close's own offering includes automated workflows that Chloe can run inside, workflow management via sequences, and Chloe, an AI agent that calls leads, qualifies them and updates the CRM automatically, so background automation is a first-party capability. The evidence is mostly pricing and marketing lines with no in-depth documentation of how automations are configured, triggered or run. Missing for 10: documentation of workflow triggers and conditions, evidence of recurring or scheduled background execution, configuration depth for Chloe-driven automations, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
